title: Marketing Co-ordinator
company: Sue Ross Recruitment Ltd - Agency - Permanent
description:
Sue Ross Recruitment are delighted to be working with a highly successful and expanding Sheffield-based business, operating within the construction and industrial products sector, to recruit an experienced Marketing Co-ordinator.

This is an exciting opportunity for a creative, hands-on marketing professional who can confidently take ownership of content creation and digital marketing activity from day one. Working within a small marketing team and reporting directly to the Marketing Director, you will play a key role in increasing brand awareness and engagement across multiple channels.

Key Responsibilities:
- Creating engaging content for social media platforms including LinkedIn, Instagram and YouTube
- Filming, editing and publishing video content
- Developing and implementing social media campaigns to drive engagement and brand visibility
- Producing marketing materials including brochures, product literature and promotional assets
- Working with sales teams to fulfil marketing collateral requests
- Monitoring campaign performance and making recommendations for improvement
- Assisting with influencer and partnership marketing activities
- Ensuring brand consistency across all marketing communications

The Successful Candidate Will Have:
- Proven experience within a marketing role, ideally with responsibility for content creation and social media management
- Strong working knowledge of the Adobe Creative Suite
- Experience of filming and editing video content for digital platforms
- Excellent copywriting and communication skills
- The ability to work independently and manage multiple projects simultaneously
- A proactive, hands-on approach with the confidence to hit the ground running
- Experience within a product-led, manufacturing, industrial or construction-related environment would be advantageous but is not essential

What's on Offer:
- Salary up to 35,000
- Full-time permanent position
- Office-based role in Sheffield
- Working hours of 8:30am to 5:00pm Monday to Thursday and 8:30am to 4:00pm Friday

Unfortunately due to the number of applications we receive, we are unable to provide individual feedback to all applicants. Please assume that if you do not hear from us within 72 hours that your application has been unsuccessful on this occasion.

May we take this opportunity to thank you for expressing an interest in one of our roles and wish you the very best in your search for employment.

title: Ecommerce Marketing Executive
description:
Ecommerce Marketing Executive Consumer Goods Office-Based

Want to be part of an eCommerce team that's building something exciting?

We're working with a growing consumer goods business that is investing in its eCommerce operation and looking to expand its digital presence across Amazon, Shopify and other online channels.

They're now looking for an Ecommerce Marketing Executive to join the team and play a key role in driving the next stage of online growth.

This is a hands-on role with plenty of opportunity to learn, develop and make an impact.

You'll Be Involved In:
- Amazon and Shopify content and optimisation
- Product listings, online merchandising and digital content
- Supporting Amazon advertising and promotional campaigns
- SEO, keywords and conversion optimisation
- Website and marketplace performance
- Email and digital marketing activity
- New product launches
- Competitor and market analysis
- Reporting and identifying opportunities to increase online sales

We're looking for someone with experience in eCommerce, digital marketing, online retail or marketplaces, ideally with exposure to Amazon and/or Shopify.

More importantly, you'll be commercially minded, digitally savvy, proactive and keen to develop.

This is an opportunity to join a business at an exciting stage of its eCommerce journey, working closely with the Ecommerce Manager and wider management team as the division grows.

If you're ready to take the next step in your eCommerce career and want to be part of a business with ambitious plans for online growth, get in touch.

Contact:

Shelley Velati

Reference: SV/45679

Location - Sheffield (Office Based)

Sector - Consumer Goods

Candidate care:

If your application is successful we will contact you to discuss the opportunity in more detail, within 48 hours of receiving your application.

In the meantime, we would like to thank you for your interest in Cavendish Maine.

title: Marketing Executive
company: Andy File Associates Limited - Agency - Permanent
description:
Andy File Associates Limited is working as a Recruitment Agency on behalf of our client with regards to this permanent position.

About the Role

Our client is looking for a proactive and creative Marketing Executive to support the delivery of marketing activities across both organic and paid channels.

This is a varied, hands-on role suited to someone who enjoys creating engaging content, managing social media activity and supporting marketing campaigns, while also building relationships with clients and representing the business at meetings, networking opportunities and events.

The successful candidate will be confident working across multiple projects, communicating with clients and ensuring marketing activity is delivered professionally, effectively and in line with agreed objectives.

The role offers a hybrid working arrangement, combining remote working with on-site attendance, client meetings and events as required.

Key Responsibilities

Content Creation and Marketing Delivery
- Create engaging marketing content and promotional materials for organic and paid channels.
- Plan, schedule and publish social media content, ensuring activity is consistent and aligned with the brand.
- Support the delivery and optimisation of marketing campaigns across relevant platforms.
- Monitor campaign performance, produce basic reports and identify opportunities for improvement in line with agreed KPIs.
- Contribute creative ideas to support brand awareness, audience engagement and wider marketing objectives.

Client Liaison and Account Support
- Liaise directly with clients to understand their requirements, gather information and manage feedback.
- Maintain clear and professional communication with clients to ensure projects progress effectively.
- Attend client meetings, networking opportunities and sales meetings as required.
- Support the coordination and delivery of marketing activity in line with client expectations and agreed deadlines.

Events and Brand Representation
- Attend networking events, business functions and other relevant events to promote and represent the company.
- Act as a professional ambassador for the brand when interacting with clients, partners and prospective customers.
- Participate in marketing shoots and promotional activities, including appearing in marketing materials where required.

Teamwork and Ways of Working
- Work collaboratively with colleagues to support the delivery of marketing plans and business objectives.
- Manage multiple tasks and deadlines effectively, maintaining a high standard of work.
- Work flexibly within a hybrid arrangement, attending on-site meetings, activities and events when required.
- Attend regular company meetings and events, providing appropriate notice to the line manager if unable to attend, except in emergencies.

Essential Skills and Experience

To be considered for this role, candidates must demonstrate:
- Essential knowledge of Instagram and LinkedIn, including an understanding of how each platform can be used effectively for marketing.
- Proven practical experience of posting content on Instagram and LinkedIn, including creating, scheduling and publishing posts.
- Experience creating marketing content and materials across organic and paid channels.
- Strong communication and interpersonal skills, with confidence in a client-facing environment.
- Excellent organisational skills, with the ability to manage competing priorities and meet deadlines.
- A proactive, creative and professional approach to marketing delivery.
- Confidence representing a business in client meetings, networking environments, at events and during marketing shoots.
- The ability to work independently while contributing effectively as part of a team.

Working Hours and Flexibility
- Monday to Friday, 40 hours per week.
- Hybrid working, with a combination of remote and on-site attendance.
- Some early mornings and evenings will be required to accommodate networking events, client meetings and other business activities. These will form part of the role's working commitments.

Candidates must be comfortable with the flexibility required to attend relevant meetings and events outside standard office hours when necessary.

Performance and Development

Key performance indicators (KPIs) and targets will be established and reviewed through regular performance review meetings. These will help monitor progress, assess performance and support ongoing development and progression within the role.

Recruitment Process

As part of the selection process, shortlisted candidates will be required to complete a practical marketing task and deliver a short presentation outlining their work.

Both the task and presentation must be completed successfully before an offer of employment can be made.

How to Apply

If you have hands-on experience creating and publishing content across Instagram and LinkedIn, enjoy working in a varied marketing role and are confident building client relationships and representing a business, we would welcome your application.

title: Marketing Executive
description:
About the Role

Our client is looking for a creative and proactive Content & Communications Marketing Executive to join its growing marketing team. Reporting to the Marketing Manager, you'll own the company's social media, create engaging content, deliver email campaigns and coordinate events and exhibitions.

This is initially a 9-month contract, with a view to the role becoming permanent.

Key Responsibilities
- Create engaging content for social media, websites, email, case studies, blogs and marketing collateral, including graphics, photography and video.
- Manage LinkedIn, Instagram, Facebook and YouTube, including the content calendar, scheduling and performance reporting.
- Plan, design and deliver email campaigns and newsletters, tracking results and recommending improvements.
- Work with the Digital Marketing Executive to update website content, landing pages and news articles.
- Coordinate exhibitions, trade shows and company events, including stand graphics, logistics and promotion.
- Maintain a consistent brand identity and tone of voice across all channels.

Essential Skills & Experience
- Experience in a content, communications or social media marketing role, ideally B2 B.
- Excellent copywriting, editing and proofreading skills.
- Experience delivering email marketing campaigns.
- Proficiency in Adobe Creative Cloud and Canva, plus photo and video editing.
- Experience with WordPress, Statamic or a similar CMS - desired, not essential
- Strong organisation, attention to detail and the ability to manage multiple deadlines.

Desirable
- Experience in construction, health and safety, training or technical B2 B sectors.
- Familiarity with Brevo or Mailchimp, SEO and marketing analytics.
- Experience coordinating exhibitions or corporate events.

Benefits
- Competitive salary (depending on experience)
- 21 days holiday + bank holidays, increasing with service
- Company pension and private healthcare
- On-site parking
- Regular team events and a supportive, collaborative culture
- Hours - Monday-Thursday 8am-4.30pm, Friday 8am-2pm

title: Marketing Executive
description:
Role: Marketing Executive - Sheffield

Salary: £35k per annum DOE

Hours: 34.5 hrs per week, Mon-Thurs: 08.30 to 16.45 (30 min lunch break) & Fri: 08.30 to 12.00 (no lunch break)

Benefits:
- Pension: ERs Cont. 5% & EE Cont. 5%
- Group Life Cover: x 2 basic salary
- Annual Leave: 35 days including UK statutory bank holiday
- Staff Bonus Scheme (dependent on overall business performance)

Position Overview:

Elevation Recruitment Group are delighted to be partnering with a business that designs and manufactures hazardous area lighting for safe use in explosive atmospheres.

Reporting to the Marketing Manager, you'll join a small, collaborative marketing team where you'll enjoy a varied, hands-on role covering the full marketing mix. This is an excellent opportunity for someone who enjoys owning projects from concept through to delivery and is keen to broaden their experience across digital marketing, content, events, product marketing and communications.

While specialist agencies support areas such as PPC, website development and design, you'll manage many day-to-day marketing activities in-house and act as a key liaison between the business and external partners.

Responsibilities:

Digital Marketing & Content Management
- Deliver agreed multi-channel digital marketing activity-including website updates, landing pages and SEO/content optimisation-working closely with our external digital agency on targeted B2 B lead generation campaigns.
- Manage email marketing campaigns in HubSpot, including audience segmentation, automated workflows, lead capture forms and campaign performance analytics.
- Lead the day-to-day management of social media channels (organic and paid), creating engaging content calendars to drive B2 B audience growth.

Product Marketing & Sales Enablement
- Turn complex technical information from technical teams into clear, customer-focused collateral, datasheets, brochures, and case studies.
- Support new product launches by coordinating promotional assets, approved campaign messaging and marketing deliverables.
- Provide day-to-day marketing assets, presentations and collateral to support the internal sales team and international distributor network.

Events & Exhibitions
- Plan and execute industry trade shows, exhibitions and customer events throughout the year.
- Manage event logistics, stand assets, lead-capture processes and coordinate post-event nurture campaigns to maximise event return on investment.

Agency Liaison & External Communications
- Serve as the primary day-to-day contact for external agencies (PPC, web, design and PR), ensuring projects, ad placements and assets are delivered on time and on brand.
- Support trade press advertising, PR opportunities and internal communications, such as company newsletters.

Asset Management, Analytics & Operations
- Track campaign performance across different platforms, compiling clear performance reports for the Marketing Manager.
- Maintain marketing project plans, content calendars and trackers, proactively following up outstanding information, actions and approvals to keep activity on schedule.
- Produce in-house multimedia content (photography, basic video production) and maintain organised digital asset libraries with strict version control.
- Assist with routine marketing administration, including purchase orders, supplier coordination, budget tracking and basic e-commerce listing maintenance (Amazon).
- Proofread and quality-check marketing materials for accuracy, consistency and compliance with brand guidelines before they are submitted for approval and publication.
- Carry out competitor research and market monitoring to identify industry trends.
- Perform other reasonable marketing duties as required to support business objectives.

Skills & Experience Required:
- A minimum of three years' experience within a broad B2 B marketing role.
- A strong understanding of digital marketing principles.
- Experience using CRM and email marketing platforms such as HubSpot.
- Website content management experience.
- Knowledge of SEO best practice and content optimisation.
- Experience coordinating marketing campaigns from planning through to reporting.
- Strong copywriting and content creation skills.
- Excellent organisational and project management abilities.
- Confidence working with external agencies and internal stakeholders.
- Strong Microsoft Office skills - especially Excel and PowerPoint.
- Adobe Photoshop and InDesign.
- Basic video editing experience.

Although a recognised marketing qualification, such as a marketing degree, CIM qualification or equivalent, would be desirable, strong relevant practical experience and evidence of continued professional development will also be considered.

Desirable:
- Google Analytics 4 and Google Search Console.
- SEMrush.
- Adobe Illustrator and Premiere Pro.
- AI-assisted marketing tools.
- Experience managing Amazon Marketplace listings.
- Experience within manufacturing, engineering or technical B2 B environments.

title: Programme Marketing Contractor URGENT
description:
Contract: Fixed-term, c.9 weeks (16 November 2026 - 15 January 2027)

Days: 5 days a week until 11 December, then 3 days a week to 15 January

Work model: Hybrid

About National Education Group (NEG)

National Education Group (NEG), a leading EdTech SaaS business in the global education sector, backed by Synova. Through platforms including The National College, NEG supports over 54,000 institutions and more than 1.5 million educators worldwide, work recognised with 21 major EdTech awards, including Supplier of the Year on multiple occasions.

The Role

We're looking for a hands-on multichannel campaign marketer to lead integrated, conversion-focused campaigns this winter. You'll own November and December campaigns, get New Year activity planned early, and keep every email going out on time.

We work B2 B2 C: we reach schools and trusts as organisations, and educators as individuals. That means your campaigns will drive both lead generation and online digital sales.

What You'll Deliver

Integrated campaign delivery
- November and December campaigns: own integrated campaigns across email, paid media, organic social, website and landing pages, and get every one launched on schedule
- New Year planning: agree objectives, themes and audiences for January, and have briefs and channel plans ready before the December break
- Always-on activity: refresh, repurpose and optimise ongoing campaigns so they work alongside topical activity, never against it

Audiences and propositions
- Segments and TAMs: plan campaigns for different audiences, from school and trust leaders to individual educators, adapting messaging, propositions and calls to action for each
- New Business campaigns: engage non-members with insight and sector updates that convert into membership enquiries, demo requests and PAYG sales
- Reactive PAYG campaigns: when Department for Education guidance changes, get relevant training in front of the right audience across the right channels, aiming for 24 hours from announcement to launch

Creative and execution
- Creative briefing: turn campaign objectives into clear briefs for Design, Content and Digital, keeping messaging and creative consistent across every channel
- HubSpot build and send: write, build, QA and schedule emails, landing pages, forms and simple nurture sequences using our existing templates

Performance and collaboration
- Conversion and testing: track engagement, leads, digital sales and pipeline; run at least one A/B test a month; and share a monthly summary with clear recommendations
- Stakeholders: keep Content, Design, Digital, Product Marketing and Sales aligned, and brief Sales on every launch
- Handover: leave a clear handover, covering live campaigns, the roadmap, open briefs and key contacts

What You'll Bring

Essential
- Multichannel campaign management: you understand how email, paid media, organic social, website and landing pages work together, and you've co-ordinated integrated campaigns across them
- Segment and TAM management: you've planned and run campaigns across multiple audiences, segments and TAMs, tailoring messaging, propositions and calls to action for each
- Direct-response marketing: you write conversion-focused copy and shape creative across email, web, landing pages and digital ads, and you know what drives engagement, leads and digital sales
- Creative briefing: you turn campaign objectives into clear briefs that Design, Content and Digital teams can run with
- Commercial and conversion focus: you're confident with conversion optimisation, testing and campaign data, and you spot opportunities to improve results across both lead generation and online sales
- Hands-on HubSpot execution: you build emails, landing pages, forms, lists and simple workflows in Marketing Hub without needing support
- Ready to hit the ground running: you're comfortable picking up live campaigns in week one

Nice to have
- Experience in a B2 B2 C model, or marketing to education, membership or subscription audiences
- Familiarity with the UK schools sector or the DfE policy landscape

Ready to apply?

Send your CV, a couple of campaign emails you've written and built, and your availability from 16 November. We're aiming to have someone in place by mid-November, so we'll move quickly

Job Benefits

At TNC, we're passionate about helping organisations grow and thrive through knowledge and connection. You'll be part of a company that values people, encourages personal development, and celebrates success. You'll work with people who value collaboration, innovation, and high standards.

You'll also be able to benefit from:

Your Wellbeing
- 24/7 mental health support and GP access for you and your family
- Personal fitness, nutrition, legal and financial support
- Free flu jab every winter

Your Time
- 25 days plus bank holidays rising to 30, with the option to buy or sell days
- Birthday off
- Paid charity day
- Genuinely flexible working

Your Future & Family
- Enhanced family pay from day one
- 5% employee (including 1% tax relief) and 3% employer pension contribution
- Life assurance 4x salary

Your Growth
- 3 weeks expert led onboarding
- Commercial sales training
- Bites and insights sessions
- Professional development with time and support
- One professional subscription covered annually

Our Culture
- Regular socials and collaboration days
- Annual summer and winter parties to celebrate our successes
- Free barista quality coffee, fruit, snacks and drinks in our office

title: Retail & Brand Partnership Executive
description:
Role: Retail & Brand Partnership Executive- Sheffield

Salary: £30,000 - £35,000 per annum

Hours: 9am- 5pm Monday- Friday (flexibility)

Benefits:
- Available on request

Position Overview:

This role forms an integral part of the brand partnership and Commercialisation Team. This role will support the identification, development and delivery of income-generating opportunities, including pop-up retail, brand experiences, promotions, events, filming and experiential installations. Working under the guidance of the Commercialisation Managers, the role combines partner engagement, commercial coordination, operational delivery, compliance and performance reporting.

The role is responsible for supporting the full lifecycle of commercialisation activity, from responding to enquiries and developing proposals through to coordinating delivery, monitoring performance and maintaining accurate records. You will build effective relationships with brand partners, agencies, occupiers and internal teams, contribute to income and visitor-experience objectives, and progressively take ownership of agreed projects and accounts.
- Support the generation and conversion of commercial enquiries, preparing proposals, schedules and supporting information for prospective brand partners, pop-up retailers, promoters and agencies.
- Use social media, including LinkedIn, to raise the profile of the commercialisation team, showcase successful activations, develop industry relationships and generate new income opportunities, working within agreed brand and communications guidelines.
- Plan and maintain a pipeline of relevant social media content, collaborating with marketing colleagues and partners to source stories, imagery, case studies and commercially focused updates.
- Coordinate the end-to-end delivery of agreed activations, including site selection, documentation, approvals, operational planning, arrival, trading and departure.
- Develop strong day-to-day relationships with partners and stakeholders, providing a responsive, professional and commercially focused service.
- Ensure activity complies with centre standards, contractual requirements, health and safety procedures and relevant legislation.
- Maintain an accurate commercialisation pipeline, booking records, income data and account reconciliations, escalating risks or variances promptly.
- Use Excel to maintain and analyse commercial performance data and prepare accurate monthly management team reports, dashboards, presentations and case studies covering income, pipeline, occupancy, forecasts, social media engagement and customer feedback, highlighting trends, risks and recommended actions.
- Actively explore, adopt and share appropriate new technologies, including machine learning and automation tools, to streamline processes, improve reporting and enhance team efficiency, while following company policies on data security, governance and responsible use.
- Attend progress meetings, contribute ideas for new revenue opportunities and provide cover or support across the wider commercialisation portfolio when required.

KPI's
- Contribute to the delivery of the commercialisation business plan, including income, occupancy, visitor-experience and partner-satisfaction objectives.
- Build and maintain a healthy pipeline of relevant brands, operators, promoters and agencies, using LinkedIn and other appropriate social media channels to identify prospects, start conversations and progress opportunities in a timely manner.
- Build the team's external profile through regular, engaging social media content that demonstrates commercialisation expertise, celebrates partner success and supports lead generation.
- Deliver well-planned, safe and high-quality activations that enhance the asset and minimise disruption to customers and occupiers.
- Demonstrate sound commercial judgement in preparing proposals, monitoring agreed terms and identifying opportunities to improve income or efficiency.
- Build productive, long-term relationships with customers, occupiers, community partners and internal stakeholders.
- Support the review and performance management of appointed commercialisation, brand and marketing agencies.

Skills and competencies:
- Strong written and verbal communication skills, with a collaborative and customer-focused approach.
- Commercial awareness and an interest in retail, brands, events, media or experiential activity.
- Confidence using social media, particularly LinkedIn, to create engaging content and build professional networks.
- Strong numerical and analytical skills, with the ability to interpret budgets, income and performance data.
- Excellent organisation and attention to detail, with the ability to manage competing priorities and deadlines.
- Good judgement, initiative and a proactive approach to solving problems and making recommendations.
- Strong Excel skills, including formulas, pivot tables, charts and reporting, alongside proficiency in Microsoft Office.
- Curiosity and adaptability, including an interest in using emerging technology and automation to improve productivity.
- A professional and flexible approach, including occasional travel or activity outside standard working hours.

Desirable
- Experience within a retail or leisure destination.
- Event management experience.

title: Trainee Digital Marketing Manager No experience needed (Ref: 6901)

Apply Today

If you are looking to start a career in Digital Marketing and want to gain practical experience while developing a professional portfolio, we would love to hear from you.

Submit your application today and begin your journey towards a career in one of the world's fastest-growing industries.

We advertise this role across multiple UK locations - you only need to apply once and you'll be considered for all of them.
